items.name: Divine Shop
items.look: a luxury glass boutique pavilion with a sweeping curved white roof on slim gold columns; inside, lit display shelves with glowing comets in glass domes and potion bottles; a marble counter with a gold cash register shaped like a planet; a big empty gold-framed sign panel above the entrance (no text); warm interior light

items.name: Leaderboard Monument
items.look: a tall white marble monolith holding a huge dark glass screen panel framed in brushed gold (blank screen, no text), three podium steps in front (gold, silver, bronze inlays), small stone planets orbiting the top on thin gold rings

items.name: Fusion Reactor
items.look: a circular white marble platform with three glass capsules each holding a comet, curved gold arms meeting above a central glass sphere full of swirling cyan-violet energy, glowing conduits running across the floor, control lectern in front

items.name: Cosmic Hunt Portal
items.look: a tall elegant ring of white stone and gold standing on a stepped marble base, inside a swirling blue-violet vortex of light, broken ring segments floating around it, steps leading up to it

items.name: Family Forge
items.look: an open celestial forge where the family weapons are displayed: a white stone anvil with a glowing comet on it, five weapon racks in a half circle (hammer, lance, mace, maul, scythe shapes, each topped with a stone comet head), a brazier with violet cosmic fire

items.name: Trade Plaza
items.look: a round marble plaza with a central gold-framed glass table, two facing stone benches, a tall slim gold obelisk with a floating star on top, soft light strips in the floor

items.name: Daily Star Chest
items.look: a big celestial treasure chest of white marble and gold with star patterns, the lid slightly open with warm light and small floating stars coming out, on a small round pedestal

items.name: God Statue (spawn)
items.look: the centerpiece of the central island: a giant heroic white marble statue of a young god holding a stone comet above his head, on a round tiered gold and marble base with a fountain of glowing cyan water around it

items.name: Launch Pad
items.look: a round floating platform of white stone with a glowing cyan ring inlaid in the floor and gold trims, a thin gold railing on the back half, soft energy glow rising from the ring, rough rock underneath like a floating islet

items.name: Bifrost Gate
items.look: the gate at the start of a glowing cosmic glass bridge: two slender white pylons with gold inlays joined by a floating glass arch with a glowing constellation pattern, light strips leading forward

items.name: Comet Pedestal
items.look: an elegant pedestal where a comet floats: a short white marble column with a gold bowl on top and a ring of soft cyan light hovering above it (empty, no comet)

items.name: House Upgrade Lectern
items.look: a marble lectern with a tilted gold top plate engraved with a small house-and-star symbol (no text), soft glow under the plate

items.name: Bridge Lamp
items.look: a tall slim light pylon of glass and gold for the cosmic bridges, a glowing star orb on top

items.name: Star Lamp
items.look: a slim garden lamp post in brushed gold with a frosted glass orb holding a tiny star

items.name: Meteor Sculpture
items.look: a rough glowing meteor fragment on a white marble plinth with a gold ring around it

items.name: Armillary Sphere
items.look: a large gold armillary sphere on a marble base with a small glowing planet in the middle

items.name: Crystal Planter
items.look: a white stone planter with luminous cosmic plants and small cyan crystals

items.name: Cosmic Tree
items.look: a sculptural tree with a pale trunk and a canopy of soft glowing violet leaves, in a round stone bed

items.name: Floating Stepping Stones
items.look: a path of five flat white stepping stones floating at different heights with a soft glow under them

items.name: Star Telescope
items.look: a big elegant brass and white telescope on a tripod pointing at the sky

items.name: Celestial Bench
items.look: a curved white marble bench with gold armrests and a constellation pattern on the seat back

items.name: Star Fountain
items.look: a minimalist fountain: a stack of three offset marble slabs with glowing water falling between them

items.name: Floating Rock Cluster
items.look: a cluster of three chiselled grey space rocks with thin glowing violet cracks, floating, for the edges of the islands
